methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
An extensive investigation of a novel thermodynamic trigeneration cycle, operating with two-
phase expanders and compressors and single-component wet working fluids, is carried out.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Thermodynamic optimization and working-fluid selection study of a novel trigeneration (CCHP) cycle with two-phase expanders/compressors, analysed by Aspen Plus steady-state simulation and sensitivity analysis. The 'energy performance indicators' it evaluates are cycle thermodynamic efficiencies (cooling/electric/heating efficiency, EUF, primary energy saving), not an EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model in the ISO 50001/50006 sense. No energy baseline, normalization/regression model, EnMS, or ISO 50001/50006 context is present; this is an energy-conversion system design, not an organisational/facility energy-performance measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
simulation model of the thermodynamic cycle in steady state conditions is used to 
perform an extensive sensitivity analysis

stage1.notes: Terminological false-friend: 'energy performance indicators' here are thermodynamic cycle efficiencies of a CCHP design, not ISO 50006 EnPI/EnB models. Zero ISO 50001/50006, energy-baseline, regression/normalization or continuous-process facility content. Genuine eligibility borderline -> Tier-1 human blind-first adjudication.
